reasons.A: Closest sentence movement: blunt short assertions set against long semicolon-joined periods, a rhetorical question and an exclamation, 'I fancy', and an aphoristic argumentative stance; loses a little for the modern 'won't' and 'The point is'.
reasons.B: Good period diction and confiding first person with dashes and parentheses, but the rhythm is more evenly flowing and chatty, with fewer of the passage's abrupt short turns, questions and epigrams.
reasons.C: Plain modern register with uniform mid-length sentences, almost no semicolons, dashes, questions or exclamations, and an expository rather than wry, confessional stance.
